WITH
    (
        SELECT any(ChannelKey)
        FROM retail.DimChannel
        WHERE lower(ChannelName) LIKE '%online%'
    ) AS online_channel_key,
    forecast AS (
        SELECT sum(coalesce(SalesAmountQuota, 0)) AS forecast_sales_amount
        FROM retail.FactSalesQuota
        WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
          AND toQuarter(DateKey) = 4
    ),
    actual AS (
        SELECT sum(SalesAmount) AS actual_sales_amount
        FROM
        (
            SELECT SalesAmount
            FROM retail.FactSales
            WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
              AND toQuarter(DateKey) = 4

            UNION ALL

            SELECT SalesAmount
            FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
            WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
              AND toQuarter(DateKey) = 4
        )
    )
SELECT
    forecast.forecast_sales_amount,
    actual.actual_sales_amount,
    actual.actual_sales_amount - forecast.forecast_sales_amount AS variance_amount,
    if(
        forecast.forecast_sales_amount = 0,
        NULL,
        round(actual.actual_sales_amount / forecast.forecast_sales_amount * 100, 2)
    ) AS actual_vs_forecast_pct,
    if(
        forecast.forecast_sales_amount = 0,
        NULL,
        round((1 - abs(actual.actual_sales_amount - forecast.forecast_sales_amount) / forecast.forecast_sales_amount) * 100, 2)
    ) AS forecast_accuracy_pct
FROM forecast
CROSS JOIN actual
